content.description: Set this field, if content needs to be returned.

fileOperationSpec.description:
{@link FileOperationSpec} for tuning the upload/download of file artifacts associated with a model card
to/from {@link ModelRegistryService}.

plotMode.description:
Specify how to fetch the plots from Model Registry Service. Default is "download", if no option is provided.
If set to "download", plots are downloaded into the file system of user application.
If set to "endpoint", only file endpoint in Model Registry Service is returned and user application should fetch the file from the endpoint.

fileMode.description:
Specify how to fetch the files from Model Registry Service. Default is "download", if no option is provided.
If set to "download", files are downloaded into the file system of user application.
If set to "endpoint", only file endpoint in Model Registry Service is returned and user application should fetch the file from the endpoint.

title:
Spec for customization of {@link ModelRegistry#card}, {@link ModelRegistry.Entry#card} and {@link ModelRegistry.Entry.CardMetadata#card}.
By default, reading a card returns metrics, parameters, and content associated with a card.
If plots and files are needed, this spec should be used.
If this spec is used, only fields that are requested in this spec are returned.

Additionally, There are 2 options for reading plots/files
1. Download to user application - this option is useful if users want to download files/plots for updating from jupyter notebook.
2. Provide file endpoint from Model Registry Service - This enables direct download, preferably from the browser.
name: ModelRegistry.Entry.CardReadSpec
